entries.name: revit_get_active_document
entries.title: get active document
entries.summary: Get metadata about the active Revit document. Returns document title, path, worksharing status, and Revit version.
entries.when_to_use: Identify active document; not binding authorization.

entries.name: revit_get_connectors
entries.title: get connectors
entries.summary: Get MEP connectors of an element (equipment, fittings, etc.). Args: element_id: The Revit element ID (as string). document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a list of connectors with their ID, type, direction, co
entries.when_to_use: Connector topology read is NOT implemented by the current native Revit bridge (HTTP 501); do not invoke until reviewed host readback fixture exists.

entries.name: revit_get_element
entries.title: get element
entries.summary: Get a single element by its ID. Args: element_id: The Revit element ID (as string). document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns the element with its properties and parameters.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect specific element properties by a confirmed element ID.

entries.name: revit_get_runtime_info
entries.title: get runtime info
entries.summary: Return runtime, bridge, and open-document diagnostics without mutation.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect Revit MCP runtime health without touching project geometry.

entries.name: revit_list_annotations
entries.title: list annotations
entries.summary: List annotations in a specific view. Args: view_id: The view ID to list annotations from. annotation_type: Filter by type. Values: "text", "tag", "dimension", "spot_elevation", "detail_line". If not provided, returns all types. document_id: Optional
entries.when_to_use: List view annotations after selecting a view.

entries.name: revit_list_documents
entries.title: list documents
entries.summary: List all open Revit documents. Returns a list of document metadata including title and ID.
entries.when_to_use: List open project documents without changing binding.

entries.name: revit_list_elements
entries.title: list elements
entries.summary: List elements with optional filters. Args: document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. category: Filter by category name (e.g., "Walls", "Doors"). class_name: Filter by Revit API class (e.g., "Wall", "FamilyInstance"). fa
entries.when_to_use: Inventory actual placed instances; use category='Mechanical Equipment' to investigate FCU candidates, then inspect Family/Type and parameters before final classification.

entries.name: revit_list_families
entries.title: list families
entries.summary: List families loaded in the Revit project. Args: category: Filter by MEP category. Common values: "Mechanical Equipment", "Ducts", "Duct Fittings", "Pipes", "Pipe Fittings", "Plumbing Fixtures", "Lighting Fixtures", "Electrical Equipment", "Conduits"
entries.when_to_use: Discover loaded Family definitions; never use family count as installed equipment count.

entries.name: revit_list_family_types
entries.title: list family types
entries.summary: List family types (symbols) available in the project. Args: family: Filter by family name. category: Filter by MEP category name. document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a list of types with their ID, family n
entries.when_to_use: Discover loaded types; symbols may have zero placed instances.

entries.name: revit_list_levels
entries.title: list levels
entries.summary: List levels in the active or specified Revit document. Args: document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a list of levels with their ID, name, and elevation.
entries.when_to_use: List model Level elements and elevations, not stories inferred from view names.

entries.name: revit_list_system_types
entries.title: list system types
entries.summary: List MEP system types in the project. Args: classification: Filter by system classification. Common values: "SupplyAir", "ReturnAir", "ExhaustAir", "HydronicSupply", "HydronicReturn", "DomesticColdWater", "DomesticHotWater", "Sanitary", "FireProtectW
entries.when_to_use: Enumerate MEP system type definitions, not system instances.

entries.name: revit_list_views
entries.title: list views
entries.summary: List views in the active or specified Revit document. Args: document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a list of views with their ID, name, view type, and discipline.
entries.when_to_use: Inventory views excluding templates.
